theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (δ : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → 0 < δ → 1 ≤ k → (∀ t φ : ℝ, 0 < t → 0 < φ → φ < δ → HasMassDensity C (t • (Real.cos φ • a + Real.sin φ • e)) k ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ C.support ∩ ball (t • (Real.cos φ • a + Real.sin φ • e)) r ⊆ (Q : Set (Euclid P))) → R.Represents C → ∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < p.1 → 0 < p.2 → p.2 < δ → p.2 < 1 → (p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • a + Real.sin p.2 • e)) ∈ R.carrier ∧ R.mult (p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • a + Real.sin p.2 • e)) = k ∧ approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier (p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • a + Real.sin p.2 • e)) = Q
